tests.scope: Actual LX7 S32I/L32I guest instructions drive GPIO matrix,I2C/RMT/SPI MMIO; checks correct and incorrect routes, absent-address NACK, RTC date rollover/STOP, resets, source-bounded capacities and no inherited display.

limitations: Actual guest SPI/GPIO routing is observed only. LR1121 command responses, busy/IRQ, modulation, RF peer/range/power and Meshtastic transport are unmodeled. No chip/status reply is fabricated.
Bare HF/LF modules have exposedGPIO0 but no physical BOOT key or USB receptacle. Only Kit includes the USB adapter with BOOT/RESET and FFC.
The documentation parameter table19x22mm and the controller drawing21x41mm differ in scope; full controller model follows the explicit21x41mm drawing and native board CAD.
Native source-bounded subset only. No original factory boot, browser/WebGL or physical hardware validation claimed.
